answer: Proof-of-Replication with Proof-of-Spacetime limits Sybil agents indexing a star atlas, comet tracks, or cedar surveys by requiring each peer to seal a key-salted replica and answer random epoch challenges via zk-SNARKs. Because unique sealing stops deduplication and slow encoding prevents on-the-fly recomputation, attackers incur dedicated disk space and read IOPS per alias. However, wholesale storage operators with idle arrays can still run many valid identities.
